decisions.reason: Devore decoration fabric in several variants builds directly on the firm's core expertise in decorative curtain textiles, so management can read its sales results and adjust the variants, which makes keeping it the sensible choice.
Transparent burnout fabric is a close relative of the firm's established sheer and decoration collections, so the firm can learn from reorder data and keep the line for continuity.
This single burnout article overlaps with lines A and B, which raises some risk of rationalisation, but it fits existing knowledge and the firm's promise of stocked reorder continuity.
Velour-like upholstery fabric fits the firm's upholstery competence and its sampling and sewing service, and demand for upholstery velour has been steady, so it is worth keeping.
A flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric is a durable basic for contract and retail buyers that draws on known certification know-how, which makes dropping it unlikely.
A polyester satin lining is a staple complement to the made-to-measure sewing business with low knowledge demands and stable reorders, so it should be kept.
